# telnyx_global_ip (Resource)

A Global IP: an anycast address that delivers traffic to the WireGuard peers it is assigned to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "telnyx_global_ip" "edge" {
  name        = "edge"
  description = "Anycast address for the office"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A user specified description for the address.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the address.
- `ports` (String) A Global IP ports grouped by protocol code. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The Global IP address.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_global_ip.example <id>
```
